differences.what: Front driver: A shows a readable cone, dust cap and surround ring; B renders it as a flat pure-black disc with no detail, reading as a hole or missing part

Exposure and set: A has a graded charcoal backdrop with a soft floor glow that separates the product; B is crushed to pure black (about 88% of the frame clipped to zero), so the silhouette and right side fall into the void

Body material: A's red clear shell reads as a tinted solid with visible inner panels, though somewhat flat and plasticky; B reads as hollow glowing red wireframe edges with black interior, losing the enclosure's volume
Top unit (pod): B's chrome-red pod has crisper edge highlights and a clearer rounded silhouette; A's pod reflection is blotchy with a dark blob that reads as a dent
Hard clipped white bar between pod and cabinet in B draws the eye as an artefact
Floor reflection: both show a red reflection; A's is softer and grounded, B's is smeared and blends into the black
